name: decide-architecture-shape
job: Decide one architecture shape from options and drive it through independently verifiable convergence slices with parity proof and cutover.

inScope: Freezing source and target boundaries and acceptance invariants
Cutting vertical slices with observable jobs and parity proof
Selecting the shortest safe cutover from the real lifecycle stage
Contracting immediately after proof and reconciling the migration ledger
outOfScope: Claiming cutover completion from narrative status or stale proof

inputs: Substantial architecture change and its source/target boundaries
Customer-visible invariants, persistence surfaces, and delivery paths
Current lifecycle stage and live authority requirements
outputs: Architecture Convergence Packet with capability ledger and slice graph
Parity and cutover plan with exact-candidate proofs and rollback paths
Migration ledger reconciled from merged and deployed evidence

data: same deterministic corpus for source and target
permissions: repository write access or PR path

failureSemantics: Skipped tests, health-only probes, or successful compilation are not behavioral equivalence; proof expires and blocks promotion until exact candidate revisions and artifact digests are compared again; unclassified migration changes fail.

outcome.observable: A decided shape with each slice carrying exact-candidate parity proof, a cutover that retired obsolete structure at the real lifecycle stage, and a reconciled migration ledger reporting implementation, merge, deployment, and retirement separately.
